# XanaScript - LLM Documentation

## Overview

XanaScript is a strongly typed programming language with Portuguese keywords, an optimizing compiler (JavaScript + WebAssembly), a built-in ORM, compile-time macros, an LSP server, and zero runtime dependencies.

- Repository: https://github.com/xanascr/xs
- License: Apache-2.0
- Language: Portuguese keywords, JavaScript/WebAssembly/bytecode compilation targets
- Requirements: Node.js 18+

## Project Structure

```
xs/
  src/           Compiler source
  test/          Unit tests
  std/           Standard library
  scripts/       Build scripts
  docs/          English documentation
  bin/           CLI entry points
  package.json   npm package
  VERSION        Version file
```

Key source files:

| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| src/lexer.js | Tokenization with line/col tracking |
| src/parser.js | Recursive-descent AST parser |
| src/typecheck.js | Static type checking and inference |
| src/optimizer.js | Constant folding, dead code elimination, macro expansion |
| src/interpreter.js | AST-walking interpreter |
| src/runtime.js | Built-in functions and execution environment |
| src/codegen.js | Standard JavaScript code generation |
| src/codegen_opt.js | Optimized JS (TypedArrays, int32, type inference) |
| src/codegen_wasm.js | WebAssembly text format generation |
| src/wasm_binary.js | Direct WebAssembly binary emission |
| src/errors.js | Categorized error reporting (SINT/TIPO/NOME/IMPT/NET/RUNT) |
| src/cli.js | CLI entry point |
| src/orm.js | Built-in ORM |
| src/macros.js | Compile-time macro expansion |
| src/lsp.js | Language Server Protocol |
| src/dap.js | Debug Adapter Protocol (breakpoints, step, variables) |
| src/testrunner.js | Unit test runner |
| src/docsgen.js | HTML documentation generator |
| src/pkgmgr.js | Package manager |
| src/sourcemap.js | Source map generation |
| src/bytecode/compiler.js | Bytecode compiler |
| src/bytecode/vm.js | Bytecode VM |
| src/bytecode/opcodes.js | Opcode definitions |
| src/bench.js | Benchmark runner |

## Language Syntax (v3)

### Program Structure

A program is a sequence of statements:

```xs
cria x = 10
grita-ae(x)
```

### Keywords

```
cria, lei, fofoca, se-pah, ai, repete-na-moral, repete-enquanto,
resolve, volta, traz-ai, manda-ai, grita-ae, sussurra, horinha,
stalkeia, aguenta-ai, escolhe, desembola, bisbilhota, verdadeiro,
falso, nulo, tenta, fodeu, no-fim, assincrono, mete-o-pe,
segue-o-baile, classe, herda, spawna, esse-cara, novo, metodo,
vai-de, se-for, se-nao-der, ve-se, bateu-com, qualquer-coisa,
escuta, terminamos!, tamanho, divide-texto, encontra, decodifica-url,
juntar, crush, deu-match, date, tarefa, DB, tpm, tipo, crud,
tipo-de, instancia-de, vdd?, traduz-ai
```

### Data Types

| Type | Examples | Runtime check |
|------|----------|---------------|
| `eh-numero` | `10`, `3.14`, `-5` | `typeof === "number"` |
| `eh-palavra` | `"texto"`, `'texto'` | `typeof === "string"` |
| `vdd?` | `verdadeiro`, `falso` | `typeof === "boolean"` |
| `eh-nada` | `nulo` | `null` |
| `sla` | any value | always |
| `sus<T>` | `[1, 2, 3]` | array |
| `bagulho` | `{...}` | object |
| `crush` | class instance | object/instance |
| `sepah<T>` | optional `T` | `T` or `null` |
| `promessa<T>` | async result | Promise |
| `faz-ai` | callable | function |

### Operators

**Arithmetic:** `+` `-` `*` `/` `%` `**`
**Bitwise:** `|` `&` `^` `~` `<<` `>>`
**Comparison:** `==` `!=` `===` `!==` `>` `<` `>=` `<=` `~=`
**Logical:** `&&` `||` `!`
**Null coalescing:** `??`
**Optional chaining:** `?.`
**Spread:** `...` (arrays and objects)
**Compound:** `+=` `-=` `*=` `/=` `%=` `**=` `&&=` `||=` `??=` `|=` `&=` `^=` `<<=` `>>=`
**Ternary:** `cond ? then : else`

### Variables

```xs
cria x = 10                 // mutable
lei PI = 3.14159            // const
fofoca g = 1                // global
```

### Control Flow

**If/Else:**
```xs
se-pah (cond) { } ai { }
ai se-pah (cond) { }
```

**While:**
```xs
repete-enquanto (cond) { }
```

**For:**
```xs
repete-na-moral (cria i = 0; i < 5; i += 1) { }
```

**Break/Continue:**
```xs
mete-o-pe       // break
segue-o-baile   // continue
```

**Switch:**
```xs
vai-de (expr) {
  se-for valor: code
  se-nao-der: code
}
```

**Pattern Matching:**
```xs
ve-se (expr) {
  bateu-com pattern: code
  qualquer-coisa: code
}
```

### Functions

```xs
resolve nome(params) { volta expr }
```

Arrow functions:
```xs
(params) => expr
(params) => { }
assincrono (params) => { }
```

### Classes / OOP

```xs
classe Nome {
  spawna(params) { }
  metodo nome(params) { }
}
classe Filha herda Pai { }
esse-cara   // this
novo Classe()  // new
```

### Error Handling

```xs
tenta { } fodeu(erro) { } no-fim { }
```

### Modules

```xs
traz-ai "path"
traz-ai "path" as alias
traz-ai nome
manda-ai nome
```

### Macros (Compile-time)

```xs
tpm nome(params) { body }
```

### ORM

```xs
DB Nome { campo: TIPO }
Nome.bota-ai(obj)
Nome.vê()
Nome.acha(id)
Nome.altera(id, mudancas)
Nome.alterakkkk(id, mudancas)  // alias para altera
Nome.apaga-ae(id)
Nome.achaOnde(filter)
Nome.select(campos)
Nome.quantos?()
Nome.limpar()
```

`DB` binds the repository to a variable named after the table.

Column types: `TEXTO`/`NUMERO`/`BOOLEANO`/`DATA`/`QUALQUER` or `eh-palavra`/`eh-numero`/`eh-booleano`/`eh-data`/`eh-qualquer`.

### Testing

```xs
crush "name" { date(actual, expected) }
deu-match(cond)
```

`crush` also accepts parentheses: `crush("name") { ... }`. `mete-o-pe`/`segue-o-baile` are statements (parens optional).

### Tasks

```xs
tarefa "name" { }
```

## Built-in Functions

| Function | Description | Signature |
|----------|-------------|-----------|
| `grita-ae` | Print to stdout | `grita-ae(...args)` |
| `sussurra` | Print warning to stderr | `sussurra(...args)` |
| `horinha` | Current timestamp (ms) | `horinha()` |
| `traduz-ai` | Convert to string | `traduz-ai(x)` |
| `stalkeia` | Fetch JSON from URL (3s timeout) | `stalkeia(url)` |
| `aguenta-ai` | Sleep/delay | `aguenta-ai(ms)` |
| `escolhe` | Random integer `[min, max]` | `escolhe(min, max)` |
| `desembola` | JSON parse | `desembola(json)` |
| `bisbilhota` | Environment variable | `bisbilhota(chave)` |
| `tamanho` | Length of array/string | `tamanho(valor)` |
| `divide-texto` | String split | `divide-texto(texto, separador)` |
| `juntar` | Join array into string | `juntar(arr, sep)` |
| `decodifica-url` | URL decode | `decodifica-url(url)` |
| `encontra` | Regex match (match array or null) | `encontra(s, sub)` |
| `embrulha` | JSON serialize | `embrulha(valor, espaco?)` |
| `data-agora` | Current time as ISO string | `data-agora()` |
| `data-de-ms` | ms → ISO string | `data-de-ms(ms)` |
| `hash` | SHA-256 hex digest | `hash(texto)` |
| `url` | URL-encode a string | `url(s)` |
| `escuta` | HTTP server | `escuta(porta, handler)` |
| `terminamos!` | Stop server | `terminamos!(server)` |

## CLI Commands

English names are primary; Portuguese aliases are listed after each command.

```
xana run <file>          Run .xs (AST interpreter)              [roda]
xana vm <file>           Run .xs (bytecode VM)                  [roda --vm]
xana check <file>        Type-check without executing           [verifica]
xana fmt <file>          Format .xs                             [ajeita]
xana build <file>        Generate JavaScript                    [monta]
xana build --opt <file>  Generate optimized JavaScript          [--otimizado]
xana build --wasm <file> Generate WebAssembly (.wat + .wasm)
xana run-wasm <file>     Run .xs via the WebAssembly binary backend
xana build --standalone <file>  Generate single .js with runtime [--sozinho]
xana test [dir]          Run test files                         [teste]
xana test --watch [dir]  Watch mode for tests                   [teste --olha]
xana dev [file]          Watch mode with hot reload             [vigia]
xana repl                Interactive REPL                       [bate-papo]
xana lsp                 Language Server Protocol (stdin/stdout) [fala-com-ide]
xana debuga              Debug Adapter Protocol (stdin/stdout)
xana docs <src> <out>    Generate HTML documentation            [documenta]
xana init <name>         Create a new project                   [rascunho]
xana install <pkg>       Install a package                      [bota-ai]
xana publish             Publish current package                [solta-ai]
xana search <term>       Search packages                        [stalkeia]
xana login               Log in to the registry
xana whoami              Show logged-in user
xana logout              Log out
xana bench               Run benchmarks                         [mede]
xana help                Show help
```

## Compilation Pipeline

```
.xs source  ->  Lexer  ->  Parser  ->  Optimizer  ->  Codegen -> Output
                                                       |-> JS
                                                       |-> Opt JS (TypedArrays)
                                                       |-> Wasm text
                                                       |-> Wasm binary
                                                       |-> Bytecode -> VM
```

1. **Lexer** (lexer.js): Converts source text to tokens with position tracking
2. **Parser** (parser.js): Recursive-descent parser, generates AST
3. **Typecheck** (typecheck.js): Static type checking and inference
4. **Optimizer** (optimizer.js): Constant folding, dead branch elimination, macro expansion
5. **Code Generation**: multiple backends
   - codegen.js: Standard JavaScript
   - codegen_opt.js: Optimized JS with int32 TypedArrays
   - codegen_wasm.js: WebAssembly text (.wat) format
   - wasm_binary.js: Direct binary Wasm emission
   - bytecode/compiler.js + bytecode/vm.js: Stack-based bytecode

## Error System

Categorized errors with source code preview, arrow pointing to the exact location, hints, and did-you-mean suggestions:

```
  XSError: message
    --> file.xs:line:col
  1 | code
    | ^
  hint: suggestion
  help: documentation link
```

Categories: `SINT` (syntax), `TIPO` (types), `NOME` (names), `IMPT` (imports), `NET` (network), `ORML` (ORM), `TST` (tests), `RUNT` (runtime), `INFO` (informational). Error codes follow the pattern `CATEGORIA-NN`.

## WebAssembly Backend (wasm_binary.js)

Direct binary Wasm emission (no wat text round-trip). `runWasm(ast)` compiles, instantiates, wires the runtime imports (`grita-ae`, `sussurra`, `horinha`, `escolhe`, `tamanho`, `desembola`), exports `main` and `memory`, and calls `setWasmMemory` so strings are readable in JS.

Capabilities (parity-validated against the interpreter in `test/wasm.test.js`):
- i32/f64 arithmetic, division as f64 (JS semantics), unary minus and `!`
- `&&`/`||` via `local.tee` + `local.get` + `i32.eqz` + `if (result i32)` (no `drop` of pre-if stack values — V8 rejects that)
- If/else, while, for, break/continue with dynamic label depth (`labelDepth`/`loopStack`)
- Recursion, nested functions, function returns
- Strings as UTF-8 data segments from `STRING_BASE` (0x4000) with `tamanho` reading them
- Bool printing as "true"/"false" via string pointer

`test/memory.test.js` covers string-pool integrity, long strings, `readMemString` on the exported memory, and stable module size across repeated runs. `src/bench.js` benchmarks interpreter × VM × JS × Wasm with speedups and result consistency; `xana bench` runs it.

## Bytecode VM (60 opcodes)

Opcodes include: PUSH, POP, ADD, SUB, MUL, DIV, MOD, POW, EQ, NEQ, GT, LT, GTE, LTE, AND, OR, NOT, NEG, JMP, JIF, LOAD, STORE, CALL, RET, PRN, NEWA, NEWO, LDAT, STAT, DUP, SWAP, HALT, NULLCO, OPTMEMBER, TYPEOF, INSTANCEOF, ARR_INIT, ARR_APPEND, ARR_SPREAD, ARR_END, OBJ_INIT, OBJ_SET, OBJ_SPREAD, OBJ_END, RETURN, CALLMEMBER, STORE_MEMBER, STORE_INDEX, NEW, CLASS, LEN, SCOPE_ENTER, SCOPE_EXIT, CONST, GLOBAL.

## ORM (Object-Relational Mapping)

JSON-file-backed repository with validation. Field types: TEXTO, NUMERO, BOOLEANO, DATA, QUALQUER. Data stored in `.db/` directory with automatic `.bak` backups.

## LSP (Language Server Protocol)

Provides autocomplete (keywords, builtins, member completion after `.` with type inference), hover with inferred types, go-to-definition, diagnostics, and rename refactoring via stdin/stdout.

## DAP (Debug Adapter Protocol)

`xana debuga` runs a DAP server over stdin/stdout. Supports launch, line breakpoints, continue/next/stepIn, pause, stackTrace, scopes/variables, and evaluate. The interpreter exposes `setDebugHook(fn)` so statement-level breakpoints are driven by the AST walker (breakpoints match source lines).

## Package Manager

Registry: https://api.xanascript.dev/packages
Fallback: npm with `xanascript-` prefix
Commands: xana init, xana install, xana publish

## Source Maps

VLQ-encoded source mappings between generated JS and original .xs lines. Comment format: `//# sourceMappingURL=data:application/json;base64,...`

## Build Process

```bash
node scripts/build-all.js
```

Bundles all modules into a single executable with zero dependencies.
